notes.title: Gold Relase!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! 😎[/p][p]The famous 1.0 release has arrived, and I'm not sure how exactly to write down what I feel. For us indie developers, our games aren't just products we create and sell; they are much more. For us, Chaos on Wheels is a mission to bring car combat games to as many players as we can, to make the car combat genre relevant again, and show how fun and cool cars with weapons can be. When it all started, it was just two friends who wanted to make a small, cool game. Over time, it grew and became too big for the two of us, too big for our capabilities. [/p][p]Let's be honest, Chaos on Wheels isn't fully what we wanted to make, what you expected to be, what it could be, but it is a start, it is our first game. As some of you may assess, Chaos on Wheels isn't quite a success, and it didn't really earn the time we invested in it. Because of that, we had a tough time pushing it to the 1.0 release. We couldn't implement as many features, polish enough lots of things, add as much content, and generally take the game to the quality level we wanted. Even so, we did add some features, polished some things, fixed and improved the game as much as we could to bring it to v1.0, and we're proud of that. And now, with all the experience and knowledge we learned on this journey, we're shifting our focus to the game we all want, an online multiplayer true arena car combat game. 🔥[/p][p]1.0 release and a new game don't mean the complete end of support for Chaos on Wheels, we'll still maintain it, make necessary bugfixes, and occasional updates based on the feedback from the community. Our final goal for Chaos on Wheels is to release one more DLC in the next year. 📅[/p][p]You might also wonder why make a new game, and not just improve this one. The truth is, we overcomplicated Chaos on Wheels and made some rookie design mistakes. Since roughly 90% of the feedback, from players, but also from other developers, was that this game is perfect for online multiplayer, and Chaos on Wheels has so many design and development flaws, improving Chaos on Wheels and adding design changes to work well for online multiplayer would be more effort than new project, so we simply took what we learned, and with new experience started a new project, a project focused on online multiplayer, based on feedback from community, with thought-out design for multiplayer, and built on newest technology. 😎[/p][p]🎮 As a matter of fact, I invite you to join our alpha playtest in September, to test out and see how our determination and strong will to make the best car combat game are pushing us toward our goal. It's free, all you have to do is fill out the signup form, and you'll receive a Steam key to access the playtest. More details available on the [url="https://discord.gg/jm7Yumk3wF"]Discord server[/url]. 👈 You can check out this sneak peek of the gameplay showcase of Chaos on Wheels 2 ([url="https://youtu.be/kQId-I1qQnc"]Gameplay Chaos on Wheels 2[/url]) 👈 [/p][p]In the end, I'd like to thank everybody who supported us, cheered for us, who purchased, played, or in any way helped us get to v1.0. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. 💙💙💙[/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p]Aron the Dev[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Major Update: New Game Mode, Melee combat, Decals and more
notes.notes:
Hello there our fellow Chaos Makers! 
We're thrilled to announce our update v0.23.1.1 is finally here. With this update, we're bringing multiple major things to you. 

[h2]Game Mode - Team Deathmatch[/h2]
I hope you are a team player because teams are here. Now with the new game mode, you will never be alone, your teammates are here to steal your kills. Basically, it's the same as Deathmatch, but with two teams. Red and Blue team. Now you can destroy your brother/sister/friend/family/anybody-who-dares-oppose-you in this classic game mode of battle to the death in our splitscreen mode, and leave them and their team as sore losers. If you're not that bloodthirsty and actually wish to play with people around you, worry not. You can select to play on the same team and enjoy destroying everybody else, together. 🔵🆚🔴

[h2]Melee Combat[/h2]
This one is a sh*t tons of fun for me personally. While shooting friends down is fun but ramming them is ten times more fun. With melee attack support implemented, now you can ram other vehicles and damage them. Ramming only works with the front of the car, and damage depends on several factors. Impact direction (front/back/side of the car), speed vector, weight, front armor, bonus factors, etc. 
Also, there is something special about making other cars go airborne after knocking the hell out of them while they weren't ready. That is at least for me. Let me know how you're having fun with melee combat. 🚗💥🚙

[h2]Gamepad Aim Assist[/h2]
We understand this is skill demanding game, driving fast and aiming precisely simultaneously is indeed difficult. To make it a bit easier for our gamepad players we implemented aim assist. Aim assist works only for the gamepad, and it can be turned on or off in the settings. 🎮🎯

[h2]Car customization - Decals[/h2]
Some cars just deserve those stripes and we know it. We added support for decals, and right now even though selection is limited, we're so proud to slap those nice-looking stripes on our car and just enjoy the result. We hope you will too. 🔥

[h2]Bugfixing and balancing[/h2]
As usual, we fixed some minor issues, tried to balance things out, and made the overall experience more awesome. Let us know how you're having fun in Chaos on Wheels, and who you're playing with on splitscreen.

Thank you!
Aron the Dev

notes.title: May update - New special rockets, crosshair messages, and more
notes.notes:
[h1]A new minor update for Chaos on Wheels. [/h1]

In this update, we implemented some of the features we gathered on our [url=https://discord.gg/jm7Yumk3wF]Discord server[/url], so head out to the server and talk to us, we love hearing your feedback. 

[h2]New Special Rockets[/h2]
Two new Special Rockets are our biggest hit for this update. Special Rocket Ice and Special Rocket Follower are inspired by some older games from the genre, and we tried to convey the same feeling of those rockets in Chaos on Wheels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/ccc2b20e9daad48b7c4bdc7e4a1a975912a182d7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Special Rocket "Ice"[/h3]
Special Rocket Ice got its name because if you hit the enemy's car with it, it freezes the enemy car, disabling it completely for a short period. Your enemy becomes one big block of ice, and while it's frozen you can shoot it and make major damage to the enemy while it's defenseless. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/279809f00740348494cec40abb0d22d26c7c6f00.jpg[/img]
[h3]Special Rocket "Follower" [/h3]
Special Rocket Follower is guess what? Following enemy! - Right! 
Special Rocket Follower is a homing type rocket and if fired in the direction of an enemy, either car or turret, it will detect and crash down onto your enemy guided by high precision technology. Rocket picks enemy homing type same as Homing Missiles (Q key missiles), so make sure you change it depending on your target preferences (Default is "X" key to toggle homing type between car & turret). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/06ff95a435f040724cd82574580e3f4c85808d71.jpg[/img]
[h2]Crosshair messages[/h2]
Have you wondered many times why my rockets aren't firing, or maybe why is my gun not shooting? Probably you have, and probably the reason wasn't a bug, but either your gun was overheated, or your rocket launcher was reloading. To make it more obvious, we added "Crosshair messages". If you try to fire the main gun or rocket launcher, and it's not available at the moment, it will write you a message near the crosshair, stating why it can't do the firing. 

[h2]Fireproof Paint in Career [/h2]
From now on in the Carrer Marketplace, you can buy special fireproof paint for your car. Protect your precious ride from fire damage, and be more safe in combat. 

[h2]Career car unlocked in local play[/h2]
We know you worked hard to get your ride just right in the Career, and now you can play it in Local play without needing to unlock all the parts in local play mode. Your Career car is fully unlocked in local play, no questions asked. 

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
Several Sound Effects were improved and added to get us one step closer to better game immersion. 
We did some polish on maps Valley, Ice Road, Abandoned Race Track, and on map Military base. We also made some slight HUD and UI tweaks making it look better. With some small bugs squished that would be all for this minor update. We're looking forward to hearing from you guys, and happy chaos making! Until the next one!

notes.title: Major Update: New HUD, Car Handling, and many new features, ...
notes.notes:
To start off this new update post, first, we would like to thank you all for your patience in waiting on this major update. It took us some time, but we wanted to make it right. It was a lot of testing, tweaking, and many small changes. We hope it was worth it. 

The first major change we want to mention is the new HUD. Our goal with HUD was to be more intuitive, for players to easily recognize each part of the HUD, and to bring a new refreshment with a new design. Simplistic, but with key details to make it more elegant. The new part of the HUD is a speedometer, gear indicator, and a few additional small details about the car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/5db7923accd7d77b9ae6f2b17ace7e224280a020.jpg[/img]

The second major change is car driving. Each car has been revamped, a new gear setup, new engine sound properties, and a new acceleration. In general, all cars are at least a bit faster, and some are significantly faster. But, don't forget, weight has its part, the heavier the car, the slower it goes. We did a little drag race, just for fun, because why not? 

[previewyoutube=n_N8-iWp39w;full][/previewyoutube]

Tire reinforcement is our latest car equipment added. It's simple equipment for wheels that prevents the car from falling into the mud. No more annoying mud, huh? ;) It is also and a nice touch for those who like a more "spike-ish" look for their ride. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/84ee9c6d0aa2efb6d4345eaf56c583a56820c480.jpg[/img]

Some folks prefer low, others prefer high cars, so we added a Wheel Spring option to our car customization. With wheel springs you can adjust car height, but also spring stiffness. From Soft to Hard.

[previewyoutube=ZBV0P21GtE8;full][/previewyoutube]

We also made significant changes to car health and armor. We noticed that all cars have low health without armor, so we rebalanced the whole system. It should feel much better now. 
Alongside our regular balancing, bugfixing, and optimization, we added many smaller features to make the gameplay feel better and the visuals nicer. 

We hope you'll enjoy in this update, and until the next one, happy chaos making! 🔥

notes.title: Regular update: January 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]Minor update for Chaos on Wheels[/h1]

[h2]Health Scanner (Health bars)[/h2]

Honestly, we haven’t had in plan adding healthbars in Chaos on Wheels, but as many of you requested and suggested it, we decided to implement it. To make it more interesting, we added it as a equipment. Similar to the radar, Health Scanner is available to purchase in Market and Black Market as a “monthly” subscription. There are 4 main types of Health Scanners, each with two subcategories (Basic, Premium). Each type is defined by scanning radius, so we have Local, 4G, MASA, and StarX. Basic Health Scanner is showing health of only basic enemies, depending on the Game Mode, but Premium Health Scanner shows it all.

[h2]Car Damage Effects[/h2]

Something we had in the previous version but it lacked some polish, so we decided to make it in this one. Car damage effects work simply, when the car gets damaged it gets scratched, and when it gets damaged enough, it starts to smoke from under the hood. And when a car gets really damaged, fire on the hood catches on. So watch out for the smoke, on you and on the others 😉

[h2]Custom Car Name in Career[/h2]

We know we like to name our cars with our custom names, and we would like to give that option to you too. Head out to Chaos Career and name your car anyway you want. 

[h2]Fixed AI Spamming Homing Missiles[/h2]

One of the issues with the AI was that they sometimes spam those damn Homing Missiles, but luckily that has come to an end. We rebalanced the usage of Homing Missiles and now bots won’t spam them.

[h2]Balancing & small fixes[/h2]

As we mentioned some of the significant features above, don’t worry we have dome many minors, and of course some game balancing.

We’re currently working on the next big milestone, the “Immersion update”, so stay tuned and happy destroying! 🔥

notes.title: Roadmap & Future of Chaos
notes.notes:
Since the release of Chaos on Wheels in Early Access, we have been listening to players’ feedback, and trying to align feedback with our vision for Chaos on Wheels. We finally came up with a plan for the future of Chaos on Wheels. Our goal is to bring the enjoyment of car combat games to as many players as possible, to help them feel what we felt when we played iconic titles in the early ’00.
The illustration below is simple and with not many details, but with all the keywords that should simply illustrate our desired path. We will explain in more detail each milestone below the illustration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/8a507f005165ed6fa10ad35b980e6ae725baa46f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New content, seasonal events, continuous support[/h2]

While we have our milestones set, we’ll provide continual support with regular updates. New content, bugfixing, optimization, and seasonal events will be provided during the whole development. 

[h2]Shift Update[/h2]

Shift is our first milestone and it’s one that we accomplished even before releasing the roadmap. In Shift update, as we call it, we make a quite shift in overall gameplay. We went from “old school hardcore difficulty car combat game” to “casual destruction car combat game”. We made Chaos on Wheels significantly easier and less grindy. Read more about the Shift update also known as the Christmas update [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1623120/view/3897366645118413139?l=english]here [/url]👈

[h2]Immersion Update[/h2]

In the immersion update, our main goal will be to make Chaos on Wheels more appealing and for players to better feel car movement and combat around them. Our focus will be on creating [b]new HUD[/b], and improving [b]Visual Effects[/b], such as car damage, combat effects, and on-screen effects. The other part is improving [b]Sound Effects[/b], mostly car sounds, weapon and impact sounds, and ambient sounds. We plan to implement [b]water interaction[/b], and add [b]tutorial[/b] part explaining different [b]pickups and rocket types[/b]. Also, we plan to add smaller things such as custom car naming.

[h2]Combat update[/h2]

In the Combat milestone, we will focus on enriching gameplay and adding new gameplay features and game modes. [b]Game mode Team Deathmatch[/b] and features like [b]Melee Attack[/b] and [b]Critical Shot [/b]Chance will be must have for Chaos on Wheels. A big part of getting your dream ride ready for the mayhem is customization, so [b]Advanced performance car customization[/b] will be high on a ToDo list in the Combat milestone. Adding [b]new special rockets [/b]with their unique effects and [b]aim assist [/b]will be included in the Combat milestone as well.

[h2]Gold Release[/h2]

While we prepare for Gold Release we will work on further [b]improving AI[/b], adding [b]new map[/b], adding [b]more pickup types[/b], and generally [b]polishing[/b] and [b]optimizing[/b] every and each part of Chaos on Wheels making it worthy of becoming v1.0.

[h2]Future Expansion[/h2]

After releasing in Gold, we don’t plan to put our leg off the gas but rather continue to add more content and continue support with new smaller features, events, and bugfixing. Adding [b]new cars, drivers, and equipment[/b] will be our way of keeping Chaos on Wheels interesting long after the release. [b]DLC [/b]with [b]special cars[/b]; iconic and crossouts from other games is what we plan to do too. [b]Porting to consoles[/b] and translating to [b]new languages[/b].

[h2]Other features & changes[/h2]

There is a whole list of features we have brainstorm for Chaos on Wheels, but not everything can be add, so if you want to see something in Chaos on Wheels hop to our [url=https://discord.gg/jm7Yumk3wF]Discord Server[/url] and voter for that feature in #vote-for-feature channel. If you don’t find it on the list, feel free to add it to #ideas-suggestions channel.

Among the 100+ features and changes available to vote for, here is just a quick peek of some interesting ones:
[list]
[*] Combo attack
[*] Zombies
[*] Decal visual car customization
[*] Car radio: Custom music
[*] Cheats
[*] Skill tree
[*] Crafting
[*] Racing game mode
[*] Remove timer on Chaos Game Mode
[/list]

[h2]Online Multiplayer[/h2]

We’re happy to announce that we’re actively working on Online Multiplayer, just not as a standard part of the current Chaos on Wheels. 

Since we started developing Chaos on Wheels, new technologies have developed and a new next-gen engine has come out, and we decided to take advantage of those opportunities and make Online Multiplayer part with new and powerful Unreal Engine 5. 

[b]Chaos on Wheels: Online[/b] as we’re currently calling it will be an extension of Chaos on Wheels, but fully based on online multiplayer and with all the changes we learned and gathered through feedback. 

Development of Chaos on Wheels: Online will not affect on the current development of Chaos on Wheels, as Chaos on Wheels: Online is just an extension of Chaos on Wheels but built with more powerful technology. 

Accessing to Chaos on Wheels: Online will be exclusive to Chaos on Wheels players, and playing will be through organized playtesting during the development time. The first planned playtesting is in March of 2024. To apply for playtest you need to sign up via a form that can be found on our [url=https://discord.gg/jm7Yumk3wF]Chaos on Wheels Discord[/url] in #appy-for-playtest channel. For more info and to be in the loop of development check out [url=https://discord.gg/jm7Yumk3wF]Chaos on Wheels Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Christmas Update: Major rebalancing
notes.notes:
[h1]Overall Game Difficulty[/h1]

As we more and more talked with you; our players, we come to realization that Chaos on Wheels is a bit too difficult for modern gaming standards. Although we did base difficulty on older games such as Twisted Metal and Vigilante 8, and I’m sure we get it pretty much close, that difficulty is no longer welcome to standard modern player. In the light of that, we’re happy to say we reworked our entire system, tweaked every difficulty variable and make it much easier for new players to get up the speed.

Since sometimes cars felt like “bullet sponges”, we added new option in the settings menu for players that can adjust to get better overall game TTK (time to kill). Option [b]Global Damage Factor[/b], under gameplay settings can be adjusted for all of damages in the game. For those of you who like faster TTK, just set it to [i]HIGH [/i]or [i]HIGHEST[/i], for those who like to play on safe and have larger TTK, set it to [i]LOW [/i]or [i]LOWEST[/i], and for those who like it as it was, just leave it to [i]NORMAL[/i]. 

[h1]New Camera[/h1]

With new camera mechanics, we aimed to give players better immersion, a feeling that you’re behind the wheel of the destroying machine you drive. The feel of every acceleration and deceleration, feeling of the drift, and for players to feel the power of the car.

[h1]HUD adjustments[/h1]

With the HUD we added some light touches to be more understandable and easier to read. Added some colors, borders and background filling. We changed few icons and added car speed.
We also need to announce that we’ll do whole HUD overhaul in the next update. Stay tuned!

[h1]Christmas In-Game Event[/h1]

notes.title: CAR CUSTOMIZATION
notes.notes:
[b][i]Chaos on Wheels[/i][/b] is just as much about customizing and upgrading your cars as it is about destruction! In fact, equipping the right gadgets from within the [b]Chaos Garage[/b] will let you wreak even more havoc across the game’s many maps. But how exactly does customization work?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/6ce1d3c95bc45435bbada3e8f4c9e09443ebf003.jpg[/img]

Within the [b]Chaos Garage[/b], players can choose exactly how to customize their vehicles of destruction. Manage your special garage where you can choose to equip turrets, guns, armor, and new gadgets to make the most chaotic car possible. In total, there are five car slots available, allowing players to have a variety of builds ready at any given time. Swap different armor types, equip them individually, change front guns, select your favorite car turret, add radar, and many more things in [b]Chaos Garage[/b]!

But customization isn’t restricted to just weapons and armor. [i][b]Chaos on Wheels[/b][/i] also lets you adjust how your vehicle looks. Don’t like a car’s color? You can change it! Still not satisfied?  Swap various wraps, lights, and other options to completely personalize your ride.

There’s no shortage of ways to customize your vehicles in [i][b]Chaos on Wheels[/b][/i]. From picking the right armor, to selecting the perfect turret, and even changing your vehicle’s wheels and body type, [b][i]Chaos on Wheels[/i][/b] gives you plenty of options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/1e668fb7ffa802776cd2c833724f88f09ab887b9.jpg[/img]

[b]Chaos Garage[/b] features:
[list]
[*] 5 slots for your cars
[*] Screenshot and overlook of your cars
[*] Inventory (stuff you own)
[*] Shop (purchasing cars/armor/main-guns/front-guns/gadgets/ammo)
[*] Black Market (special offers that rotate over time)
[*] Achievements overlook
[*] Challenges overlook
[*] Profile overlook
[*] Car status overlook
[*] Driver selection
[*] Driver style/skin selection
[/list]

[b]Car Customization[/b] features:
[list]
[*] Select main gun (Turret)
[*] Select front guns
[*] Select armor
[*] Equip additional missile box
[*] Color type selection (Gloss/Matte/Metallic)
[*] Color change for car body
[*] Color change for car wheels
[*] Color change for car calipers
[*] Color change for car front lights
[*] Underglow light on/off
[*] Color change for underglow light
[*] Windows color and opacity selection
[*] Car body wrap
[/list]

But the work has only just begun! There are many new customization features in the works, which will come after the game’s Early Access launch. Car decals are one of the priorities for customization, allowing players to add custom decals/stickers on their rides. Country flags and customizable text will be available as decal options. notes.title: CHAOS WORLD
notes.notes:
Hey fellow Chaos Crew Members! 

We’re back with another update and this one is going to be interesting. As you all know, Chaos on Wheels is all about destruction and, of course, chaos. But why? What’s it all for? Other than, because it’s awesome, of course. Well, did you know that Chaos on Wheels features a pretty crazy story behind it all? We wanted to provide you with a bit more information about Helios and the world of Chaos Crew, so here’s the rundown! 

Chaos on Wheels is based in the year 2155, where technology has advanced far beyond human intelligence. Despite years of discussions about the dangers of artificial intelligence, the corporation IronCore pushed to put all technology into one interface. After that, they contracted an AI to run point on all systems. This AI was named Helios, who took control of everything in an instant. From transportation grids to communication, food production and weapons systems, it all went dark. And now the human race is endangered on all known planets due to their ambitions. 

It isn’t as though humanity didn’t try to fight back. They attacked the Mainframe but failed, resulting in even greater caution from the AI enemy. The Mainframe is now an armored self-driving truck guarded by a powerful convoy. All modern technology, from weapons to transportation is useless, and it’s all controlled by them. The only hope for humanity? A group of humans that have a love for old cars and weapons. 

This is the Chaos Crew, and this is where you come in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/787ce57ed0c9741e44d16207a67fb94daba38bd6.jpg[/img]

An eccentric and excitable group of drivers ready for adventure, the Chaos Crew may just be the last group with plans for eliminating the AI threat and taking back technology for the human race. This group is full of rage and is just vying for some epic destruction! They’ve managed to establish an HQ under the nose of Helios and his systems in order to make plans, strategize and deck out their cars with the best of what humanity has to offer. 

Each driver has their own story and their own motivations, but the goal of the Chaos Crew as a group is one thing and one thing only – take back what’s ours!

-Acodeon Team-

The March update for Chaos on Wheels is here.
As you might know, we released a demo last month, so we will outline all the significant changes we made for it. 

Let’s start with maps. 

[h2]MAPS[/h2]

We redesigned all our maps. We started the level design with the principle that the map should be just one big open area. We thought since it’s a driving game, you don’t want to focus too much on avoiding stuff on the map. But we were wrong. ❌ It’s actually way better to do maps with more style and real-world design. It just feels natural. 🌳

[h2]SINGLEPLAYER CHAOS CAREER[/h2]

Uhh, this one is great 🔥 We implemented a full singleplayer career game system.

What is Chaos Career, you might wonder? 

Chaos Career is a game system, where players manage their own garage with 5 car slots. You, as a player, can buy and sell cars, guns, armor, ammo, and gadgets, you can customize cars, upgrade them, and upgrade equipment. After you have the car of your dream, select your driver, and engage in combat of total mayhem.  Earn, cash, experience, and Chaos points to level up, unlock new equipment, and make even more chaos. A remote lumber camp placed deeply in the snowy woods now is Helios’ spot for crafting his army. Heavily guarded camp, in the middle of nowhere, with zero chance of help.

We’re proud to present you Military Map for the first time! Created with the latest feedback from you guys, the Military base is the right place to have combat with helios’ army. 

In the middle of Chaos Country lies a strategic military base full of weapons, vehicles, and war supplies, which Helios’ army won’t give up easily.

[previewyoutube=za6ehucVqoY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]OPTIMIZATION[/h2]
And of course THE optimization. Get ready for some developer rumbling hehe. 😎
It’s not that the previous state was bad, but we wanted it more optimized so we decided to focus on optimization this month.  Of course, the most important are cars and AI which are huge components of the game, so we started there. If you’re at all familiar with game development and the Unreal engine, you probably heard about the famous Blueprints. Like any other indie developer (and not indie *wink* *wink*) we used blueprints for quick prototyping. And who would think sometimes it was good enough so we leave it? Well, little by little it was enough for us to say enough. We rewrite it all (all? okay, most of it…) to C++.
Long story short, it runs faster 😲… yeah, who would guess? xD 

The AI was a tough one. It learned itself how to rule over the world and hack Facebook, so we needed it to shut it down and write a new AI. Okay, okay, that was some good bullshit, but how cool that would be? Honestly, our AI was dumb and slow and now is dumb, slow, and inefficient. Jk, jk. Now it’s just dumb and a little bit less slow. We’re still working on AI and hoping to finish optimizing it before the New year. Wish us good luck. 

TLDR: we optimized cars, and still working on AI. 😉

notes.title: Weekly Update: Special rockets
notes.notes:
[h1]DIFFERENT KABOOM[/h1]

Are you familiar with that feeling when you destroy your opponent, even tho you’re lower on health? That edge you have, that specialty? Say no more – The special rocket! 

Currently, we have 4 different types: 

[list]
[*] Mini Nuke
[*] Toxic
[*] Focus
[*] Purple Magic
[/list]

[i]Where can you get one? [/i]

That’s an easy one, just pick them up as a pickup, or reward after destroying your nemesis 😉

[i]How do you use it? [/i]

Every car has 4 rocket slots (3 special + 1 default) which can by default contain up to 3 rockets, except for infinitive default rockets. 
Toggle the current slot or directly select the slot you want to use. Easy, peasy!

[i]Why are they so special?[/i]

First of all, they deal more damage, different types of damage, and different radius of damage. Like that wasn’t enough, each of them is unique, but we don’t want to share too much, too early, we want you to find out the perks all by yourself. So…

As always check it out before it rolls out in the next steam update (coming at the end of the month!)

notes.title: Steam Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
🛣 A roadmap?! You’re probably thinking you’re dreaming. Well, you’re not! Steam Early Access roadmap is finally here. 🎉🎊🎈
We have a lot on our back, and we didn’t want to promise something we couldn’t make, so it took us a long time to create an official roadmap. Once we figure it all out, we’ve done it. So here it is 👇 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40525059/0b467cd5f9a166c8f6aa874f3ee2d5d7403d1b49.jpg[/img]

📍 Why Q3 you might wonder? We do have a planned date, but we also have a checklist of what we need to achieve to release it, hence the Q3. But don’t you worry, we’ll tell you the date right on time. 
Until then, try out the Demo. Its release is tomorrow! 🎈🎈🎈 (24/3/2022) 📆 
 
As you might see in one of the many videos we posted, our goal is to have a lot of quality game content, so in Early Access, we’re bringing you 20 amazing cars and 20 unique armors and weapons. We’re also bringing you tons of gadgets to equip on your rides. Each armor, weapon, or gadget will be available to equip on every car. All that will be possible in your own multiplayer garage. How will this work? 
 
🔧 Imagine having your own, wrench-filled garage, with 5 car spots. You did? Okay, now add tons of armor, weapon, and gadget to it. Now that’s your Chaos on Wheels garage. 🚘
 
Each player will have its garage on the server. You’ll have money that can be used to trade cars, armor, weapons, and gadgets. Money will be earned while playing against other players. In Early Access, we’ll have one multiplayer game mode. A deathmatch. Later on, we’ll add more. 
 
💵 I’ve got cash, I’ll buy everything! – Not so fast Jonny Cash. We have a level progression system. In order to buy specific weapons, cars, or gadgets, you’ll need to meet specific criteria. In some cases, it will be levels 🔟. During your destroying spree, you’ll earn experience. More exp, the higher level. We all know how that goes. 
 
🚗 The limits of car customization will always be pushed, but for starters in Early Access, you’ll be able to:
[list] 
[*]select differently armor styles
[*]equip armor individually (front/side/back)
[*]change the main turret
[*]select main gun bullet type
[*]select rocket launcher rocket type
[*]change front guns
[*]select front guns bullet type
[*]select homing missile type
[*]add fireproof paint
[*]equip radar
[*]select radar type
[*]equip additional missiles
[*]change car color type
[/list]
Every car needs its driver. Well… maybe… ahh… Anyway, our cars in Chaos on Wheels do need them, so you can pick your driver as well. Each driver has the ability that can be used in the match. From the classic nitro and shield, all the way to something only Chaos on Wheels has. 😉
You don’t buy drivers, as that seems, a little bit too weird😆. Or illegal ⛔. No, you unlock them. (yeah, much better…) 🔓 Either through leveling up or challenges, or some other ways, once you unlock it, you have it and you can select it. 
 
⚙In general, that’s how a multiplayer garage will work. ⚙
 
What about the singleplayer? 1️⃣
 
😩 We all have been there; having a rough day, and all we want is to sit back in our chair and casually destroy everything that’s virtual. In that case, you can start singleplayer custom game. Select one of three game modes (Turret battle, deathmatch, or team deathmatch), customize your deadly machine, and to the job 💥
 
But don’t think that singleplayer can’t be challenging. A no, no, no ❌ We heard that challenge is a good thing, so we added it. Let’s just say that Hard, is good ol’ fashion hard. 
During our dev freedom, we took a step even further than hard, and added game difficulty called Chaos. 🔥
We won’t tell you much about it, let the word speak for itself. 
 
🌟 Pickups are kinda self-explanatory. There are car repairing, armor repairing, weapon heat freezing, weapon heat cooldown, missile resupply, driver ability cooldown, special rocket, and so on. 
 
❔ Basic tutorial that will show you the basics. Nothing much, but it’s honest work. 
 
🦥 Basic AI – You know that first version of bots, that are there just so you’re not alone? We kinda have that type right now. We will give them a little bit 🧠, but don’t expect some amazing smart bot to play with you on an Early Access release day. They will be improved over time, it’s just not our first priority for Early Access. Honestly. 😁
 
About the features that are coming after early access and long term plans, you can find out more on our discord server 👈
You’ll be even able to vote for features that should come next. Well once we set it up 😋
Looking forward to seeing you there 😎
Ciao, until the next one!
